clear.description: Reset the tab's network buffer (DevTools "clear" button). Entries and the sequence counter restart from 1 afterwards.

detail.description: Return only this sequence's entry at full fidelity (headers + bodies). Mutually exclusive with `clear`; `since` / `limit` are ignored.

include_static.description: Include static resources (Document/Script/Stylesheet/Image/...) in the index. Defaults to false: the index only lists API-shaped traffic.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return. Extension applies safe defaults and caps.

max_text_chars.description: Maximum characters returned per URL / error text. Extension applies safe defaults and caps.

since.description: Return entries with sequence strictly greater than this cursor.

tab_id.description: Optional target tab. Defaults to the Agent Window's currently active tab.

url_filter.description: Index-mode substring filter (case-insensitive) applied to URLs.
